name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_update
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::Update invalidates during each item iteration, toggles paired entry visibility by selectedIndex, and chains to HudUiElement::Update.
known_limits: Binary Ninja marks the reconstruction limited because the original loop iterates with an entriesB cursor and renders entriesA through a negative-offset cursor artifact; the source uses typed entriesA/entriesB arrays and leaves tier S verification to the HudUiCycleSelectorWidget source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b7e60 validates the itemCount loop, per-iteration vtable Invalidate call, entriesA and entriesB visibility dispatch based on selectedIndex, and final HudUiElement::Update(deltaSeconds) call.
